study: Predeclared blinded nine-realization eBOSS DR16 matched mock-random RR and common-support pilot
stage: pre-odd random-only input and window response
required_checks: full compressed file SHA256 for each of 36 mock random files
FITS schema and all-row coordinate/weight health
numeric zero 1e-20 vs 1e-12 gap for mock candidate weight
joint LRG/ELG angular support for candidate bin and four z slices per cap
all 28800 highz fine RR cells supported
independent highz fine-to-coarse closure relative L1 <= 1e-8
highz full and deterministic disjoint half RR counts and finite-bin conditional matrix parity/constant closure
ensemble response scatter retains all nine fixed mock IDs without cherry picking
stop_rule: No mock ID, seed, cap, redshift bin, threshold or response block may be replaced, excluded or tuned based on any observed galaxy odd statistic or a mock window result. Failed or missing inputs remain documented as incomplete.
sample_size_note: Nine distinct mocks are a fixed preliminary window/input ensemble, not an estimator covariance or a calibrated observational significance test.
